rule: every input used by a bias fact must satisfy knownAt <= biasEvaluationTime
biasEvaluationTime: the closeTime of the latest fully closed native 4H candle selected by live/4hBiasV3.js latestFullyClosed (equivalently evaluationTime = latest.closeTime passed in from that selection)

checks.check: closed-candle filter at the service layer
checks.evidence: c.closed === true && c.closeTime <= evaluationTime; unclosed or future candles are structurally unreachable

checks.check: closed-candle filter at the fact layer
checks.evidence: same predicate re-applied; the fact set is built only from rows that survive it

checks.location: live/dataSource.js:314 and the two filters above
checks.evidence: an append is refused when closed !== true or closeTime > evaluationTime; test 11 proves exclusion

checks.check: rolling window indices are strictly backward-looking
checks.location: metrics.priceDelivery (t, t-24 .. t), theilSen48 (last 48), dmiAdx (recursion from index 14 forward to t), calculateAtrWilder (forward recursion to t)
checks.evidence: no index beyond t is read in any formula; all series are computed on the already-filtered visible array
a pivot at index i is only admitted when candles[i+right].closeTime <= evaluationTime; the future candle is read but its result is discarded, so no future information enters the fact value
any structuralEvent with confirmedAt > evaluationTime throws STRUCTURE_FUTURE_CONFIRMATION, so a leaking upstream would fail loudly instead of silently publishing
futureLeakViolations is assembled for protected swings, BOS events and source protected swings and throws when non-empty

checks.check: HTF refresh boundary versus evaluation time
checks.evidence: a refresh is only attempted once evaluationTime passes last.closeTime + 4h; appended rows still must satisfy closeTime <= evaluationTime

the decision store key is derived from the candle openTime/closeTime plus factsHash, promptHash, promptVersion and modelId; a restored record is re-validated against a rebuilt identity, so a stale record can never be served for a different candle or different facts

checks.check: prefix invariance of the fact builder
checks.evidence: twenty deterministic cutoffs assert that build(candles.slice(0,i+1), at) equals build(candles, at) - the fact set cannot see the future

knownNonCausalityRisks.detail: detectPivots reads candles[i+right] but discards any pivot whose confirmedAt exceeds evaluationTime; the future candle is used only as a confirmation clock, never as a value

knownNonCausalityRisks.risk: HTF increment appending a candle from an unverified source
knownNonCausalityRisks.detail: requireFutures=true (config/live.json) rejects any source !== 'futures' and records DEGRADED instead of appending
